outcome: A permanent with sunburst enters with a +1/+1 counter (creature) or charge counter (otherwise) for each color of mana spent to cast it.
Sunburst adds counters only when the object enters from the stack as a spell and colored mana was spent.
Sunburst can set a variable number for another ability, such as modular, regardless of spell type.
Each instance of sunburst works separately.
